text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has ended. Although it was a 
fruitful experience—

It also felt a bit lonely. The Umamusume 
who had always been by my side rarely 
showed up anymore.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san, um...

Even so, I decided to briefly mention what 
happened during the training camp. About 
Manhattan Cafe's "friend."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... Be it a witch or anything 
else, the subject matters little, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, what even is good and 
evil? Beyond the fence, I doubt such 
concepts even exist.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No good or evil...? My 'friend' is 
neither...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in short, it's all about 
"directionality."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Where do I want to go, and where do I want 
to take everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is North good and South evil? Or is it top 
and bottom? Who decides what is above and 
below, and from which direction?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is no good or evil, and even if 
there were, it wouldn't matter. No matter 
the intent, no matter the path taken...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If the outcome is good, then that's fine. 
So long as your 'friend's' destination 
leads to the goal you both desire.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...

Having said that much, Agnes Tachyon's 
expression suddenly turned grave.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And 'the destination reached by you two'— 
is by no means 'my destination.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Through this summer, I've come to 
understand... and I've made a decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Farewell. Cafe, Trainer. Most likely 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's dissolve our partnership. I won't be 
working with you any longer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon...-san...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't make that face. It couldn't be 
helped. In the end, it just 'wasn't it.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was young. Doing it made me realize. 
Well, even having realized it, I will 
probably fade away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take—a different path from 
you guys.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —See ya.

Agnes Tachyon turned her back and walked 
away, acting as if she had nothing to 
regret.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... somewhere...!

"An eternal farewell. So she said, but 
Agnes Tachyon was—"

Even so, I gave a light wave of my hand in 
response to Manhattan Cafe's words.
